q: Are cast iron manhole covers exported to Europe covered by CBAM?
title: Are cast iron manhole covers in CBAM?
short: No, not today. Manhole covers and gratings of cast iron are declared under 7325, cast articles of iron, which is not in Annex I of the CBAM Regulation. Your EU buyer files no CBAM figure for them, though some ask for a product footprint.
audience: Foundries in Howrah, Coimbatore, Rajkot and Kolhapur exporting manhole covers and gratings

p: Annex I covers chapter 73 only for headings 7301 to 7311, 7318 and 7326. Cast articles under 7325, such as manhole covers, gratings and counterweights, are outside it.
Covers made of steel plate or fabricated frames may be declared under 7308 or 7326, which are covered. Check what your buyer actually declares.
The Commission proposed in December 2025 to extend CBAM to some downstream steel and aluminium products. As of October 2026 that is not law, so check Annex I again before each contract season.
